title: Runtime announce interval updates do not reach scheduler
description: Node.set_config() mutates self.config.announce_interval_ms (python/src/lichen/node.py lines 1395-1411), but AnnounceScheduler owns a distinct SchedulerConfig copy created in __post_init__ (lines 380-387). Consequently /config reports the new interval while the active scheduler continues using the old one. Validate and atomically propagate runtime changes to the scheduler (including while running), with a behavioral timing/config test.
